configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Default build: CUDA and OpenMP targets when the toolchains are found.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Unoptimised with debug info; same target set as release.

configurePresets.name: relwithdebinfo
configurePresets.description: Optimised with debug info; what the sanitizer presets build on.

configurePresets.name: sanitizer-base
configurePresets.description: RelWithDebInfo: -O0 makes an instrumented run slower still, and -O2 with frame pointers keeps stack traces readable. CUDA is off because an ASan host process reports false positives from the driver's own allocations; compute-sanitizer covers device code instead.

configurePresets.name: asan-ubsan
configurePresets.description: Covers the OpenMP kernels. LeakSanitizer rides along on Linux only.

configurePresets.name: tsan
configurePresets.description: OpenMP is off: TSan cannot see an OpenMP barrier unless the runtime carries LIBOMP_TSAN_SUPPORT, and neither Homebrew libomp nor libgomp does, so every worker write reports as a race. Cannot share a binary with ASan -- separate preset, separate build tree.

configurePresets.name: cuda
configurePresets.description: Probes the installed GPUs. Needs a device present at configure time.

configurePresets.name: cuda-ci
configurePresets.description: No hosted runner has a GPU, so the architecture cannot be probed. sm_86 is the Ampere target the published numbers were measured on.

testPresets.name: release-hostonly
testPresets.description: Excludes the device suite. Hosted CI runners have no GPU, and test_cuda_kernels exits zero with a notice when it finds none -- an explicit exclusion says that, a self-skip looks like a pass.

testPresets.name: cuda-ci-hostonly
testPresets.description: The cuda-ci tree, host suites only. The device suite is built -- that is what the job proves -- but no hosted runner can run it.

testPresets.name: asan-ubsan
testPresets.description: Linux: LeakSanitizer is supported, so leaks are failures.

testPresets.name: asan-ubsan-macos
testPresets.description: LeakSanitizer is unsupported on macOS/arm64; detect_leaks=1 aborts every test. Set explicitly rather than left to the platform default.
